Package org.lucas.models

Class Prescription

java.lang.Object
org.lucas.models.Prescription
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectBase
public class Prescription extends Object implements ObjectBase
Represents a medical prescription in the healthcare system. This class is responsible for managing the details of a prescription, including a unique identifier and a list of medicines prescribed to a patient. Each prescription is uniquely identified by a UUID, which ensures that it can be distinctly traced and managed across the healthcare management system. The class also includes functionalities to add and manage the list of medicines associated with each prescription.

    • setMedicineAtIndex

      public boolean setMedicineAtIndex(String medicineName, int quantity, String dosage, int index)
      Attempts to update a medicine at a specified index in the prescription list. This method first checks if the specified medicine exists by name. If found, it uses verified details from a known database (e.g., correct dosage and price) to prevent inappropriate prescriptions. If the medicine is not found in the database, it uses the provided dosage instead. Note: If the medicines list has not been initialized, this method initializes it.
      Parameters:
      medicineName - The name of the medicine to update or add. Must not be null.
      quantity - The quantity of the medicine to be prescribed.
      dosage - The dosage of the medicine to be used if the medicine is not found in the database.
      index - The index at which to set the medicine in the list. Must be within the list's bounds.
      Returns:
      true if the medicine was found in the database and updated, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided index is out of bounds or medicineName is null.
      IllegalStateException - if the index is invalid and the list size is smaller than the index.

    • removeMedicineAtIndex

      public void removeMedicineAtIndex(int index)
      Removes a medicine from the prescription list at the specified index. If the 'medicines' list has not been initialized or if the index is out of bounds, the method will handle the situation gracefully without throwing an exception. Note: This method assumes that the 'medicines' list is properly managed elsewhere in the code to ensure that it is never null when this method is called. However, it checks for null as a safeguard.
      Parameters:
      index - The index of the medicine to be removed. Must be a valid index within the list's bounds. If the index is out of bounds, the method will complete without any action.
